problem: The air temperature $F$ in degrees Fahrenheit can be modeled by the function $F(C)=\frac{9}{5}C+32,$ where $C$ is the air temperature in degrees Celsius. Find the instantaneous rate of change of the air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit with respect to the air temperature in degrees Celsius.
